provenance.incarnation: OriginalPS2 MGS3 1964 NakedSnake, before-eye-injury two naturaleyes, nofacepaint, Mk22+CQCknife. No MGSV/Delta/otherage import.

sources.scope: Original-model Konami-copyright HD2011 press screenshot contains specifically named RAINDROP small menu swatch, bluegray/rainlike lines/rust islands. Central figure wears LEAF, no fullbody Raindrop costume photo or exact retail texture microgeometry certificate. OriginalPS2 nativebase supplies body/gear, no Delta/MGSV import.
